meta.name: alterlab-scvi-tools
meta.description: Train deep generative models for single-cell omics with scvi-tools — probabilistic batch correction and integration (scVI), reference-mapping transfer learning (scArches), differential expression with uncertainty, and multimodal models (totalVI for CITE-seq, MultiVI for multiome). Use when correcting batch effects, integrating multimodal data, or doing advanced probabilistic single-cell modeling — for standard analysis pipelines use scanpy. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.
